entries.title: I Chronicles 1:1
segments: ¶Adam, Seth, Enosh,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:2
segments: Cainan, Mahalalel, Jared,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:3
segments: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:4
segments: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:5
segments: The sons of Japheth [were] Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:6
segments: The sons of Gomer [were] Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:7
segments: The sons of Javan [were] Elishah, Tarshishah, Kittim, and Rodanim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:8
segments: The sons of Ham [were] Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:9
segments: The sons of Cush [were] Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabtecha. The sons of Raama [were] Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:10
segments: Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:11
segments: Mizraim begot Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:12
segments: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines and the Caphtorim).

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:13
segments: Canaan begot Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth;

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:14
segments: the Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite;

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:15
segments: the Hivite, the Arkite, and the Sinite;

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:16
segments: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:17
segments: The sons of Shem [were] Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:18
segments: Arphaxad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:19
segments: To Eber were born two sons: the name of one [was] Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother's name [was] Joktan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:20
segments: Joktan begot Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:21
segments: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:22
segments: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:23
segments: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these [were] the sons of Joktan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:24
segments: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:25
segments: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:26
segments: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:27
segments: and Abram, who [is] Abraham.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:28
segments: ¶The sons of Abraham [were] Isaac and Ishmael.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:29
segments: These [are] their genealogies: The firstborn of Ishmael [was] Nebajoth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:30
segments: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:31
segments: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These [were] the sons of Ishmael.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:32
segments: Now the sons born to Keturah, Abraham's concubine, [were] Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan [were] Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:33
segments: The sons of Midian [were] Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:34
segments: And Abraham begot Isaac. The sons of Isaac [were] Esau and Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:35
segments: The sons of Esau [were] Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:36
segments: And the sons of Eliphaz [were] Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, [and] Kenaz; and [by] Timna, Amalek.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:37
segments: The sons of Reuel [were] Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:38
segments: The sons of Seir [were] Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:39
segments: And the sons of Lotan [were] Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister [was] Timna.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:40
segments: The sons of Shobal [were] Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon [were] Ajah and Anah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:41
segments: The son of Anah [was] Dishon. The sons of Dishon [were] Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:42
segments: The sons of Ezer [were] Bilhan, Zaavan, [and] Jaakan. The sons of Dishan [were] Uz and Aran.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:43
segments: Now these [were] the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before a king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:44
segments: And when Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:45
segments: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:46
segments: And when Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who attacked Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city [was] Avith.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:47
segments: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:48
segments: And when Samlah died, Saul of Rehoboth-by-the-River reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:49
segments: When Saul died, Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:50
segments: And when Baal-Hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife's name was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:51
segments: Hadad died also. And the chiefs of Edom were Chief Timnah, Chief Aliah, Chief Jetheth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:52
segments: Chief Aholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:53
segments: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:54
segments: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These [were] the chiefs of Edom.
